StockMove.title: Stock Move
StockMove.description: Immutable double-entry stock-movement ledger entry (Odoo / Tryton Stock Move pattern). One StockMove atomically debits source location and credits destination location for a single (item + quantity + unit cost) tuple. Movement type taxonomy: receipt (null source = goods inbound), transfer (both locations populated = lateral move), issue (null destination = goods outbound), manufacture (assembly), repack (consolidation). Lifecycle draft → posted → cancelled; posting flips `locked = true` and triggers GL materialisation (asset / COGS) via x-openregister-lifecycle-action. Cancellation creates an offsetting StockMove (not patch) so the original posted row remains immutable per IAS 2 + Dutch CTR. No PHP StockMoveService: the lifecycle, GL materialisation and audit trail are declarative per ADR-031 (ADR-031 exception path: StockReservationGuard + StockMoveImmutabilityGuard + StockMoveOffsetCreator for the optimistic-lock CAS, the locked-after-post guard, and the offset-row materialisation that the declarative DSL cannot yet express). Reserved quantity is held against InventoryStock.reservedQuantity on draft and released on post or cancel.

movementNumber.description: Sequential movement number unique per administration + fiscal year. Operator-visible identifier (SM-YYYY-NNNN).
movementNumber.title: Movement Number

itemId.description: FK to Product.sku (inventory-product-catalog). Resolves via ?expand=itemId. Spec refers to the catalogue entity as the Item; the live shillinq catalog uses Product.
itemId.title: Item ID

quantity.description: Units moved. Always non-negative; the direction is encoded by sourceLocationId / destinationLocationId nullability and movementType. Money/quantity discipline: multipleOf 0.01 enforced so reservation CAS comparisons remain bit-exact at integer-cent.
quantity.title: Quantity

unitCost.description: Cost per unit in the administration's base currency, used to compute GL posting amounts (amount = quantity * unitCost). Manual entry or auto-filled from referenceDocumentUri (PO). multipleOf 0.01 per the shillinq Money discipline.
unitCost.title: Unit Cost

movementType.description: Closed enum of movement types. receipt: goods inbound (null sourceLocationId); transfer: lateral inter-location (both populated, no GL); issue: goods outbound (null destinationLocationId; posts COGS); manufacture: assembly (debits Finished Goods, credits Raw Materials); repack: consolidation (no GL).
movementType.title: Movement Type

sourceLocationId.description: FK to Location.id. Null for `receipt` (goods from supplier). Required for transfer/issue/manufacture/repack. Must differ from destinationLocationId when both are populated.
sourceLocationId.title: Source Location ID

destinationLocationId.description: FK to Location.id. Null for `issue` (goods to customer/scrap). Required for receipt/transfer/manufacture/repack. Must differ from sourceLocationId when both are populated.
destinationLocationId.title: Destination Location ID

referenceDocumentUri.description: Optional FK to the originating business document: PO (receipt), sales order (issue), production plan (manufacture). docudesk:// URIs supported pattern.
referenceDocumentUri.title: Reference Document URI

movementReason.description: Admin-configurable reason code. Standard codes seeded below (normal, damaged, expired, shrinkage, inter-warehouse, adjustment, sample, demo, theft, loss, cancellation, manufacture, repack); additional codes added per administration. Mandatory on transition to `posted` (StockMoveReasonGuard enforces).
movementReason.title: Movement Reason

notes.description: Free-text operator notes. Used to reference the original move on offset rows: 'Offset for SM-YYYY-NNNN'.
notes.title: Notes

draftedAt.description: Timestamp when the move was created (initialised at draft).
draftedAt.title: Drafted At

postedAt.description: Timestamp when transition draft→posted ran. Null until posting.
postedAt.title: Posted At

cancelledAt.description: Timestamp when transition draft→cancelled or posted→cancelled ran. Null unless cancelled.
cancelledAt.title: Cancelled At

administrationId.description: FK to Administration owning this move. Tenant-scoped (multi-administratie); cross-org reads/writes are masked 404 per AdministrationContextService.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

locked.description: Immutability flag set true on transition draft→posted. Once locked, edits to quantity / unitCost / locations / movementType are rejected with HTTP 409 by StockMoveImmutabilityGuard; the operator must instead create an offsetting move via the `cancel` transition.
locked.title: Locked

glTransactionId.description: Back-reference to the materialised GLTransaction for receipt / issue / manufacture posts. Null for transfer / repack (no GL posting) and for cancelled moves.
glTransactionId.title: GL Transaction ID

offsetOfMoveId.description: When this row is an offsetting (cancellation) move generated by StockMoveOffsetCreator, this field FKs to the original posted StockMove.id. Null for non-offset rows. Enables drill-down from original ↔ offset pair in the Stock Movements index.
offsetOfMoveId.title: Offset Of Move ID

lifecycleState.description: Lifecycle state. draft: operator can edit, reserves qty against InventoryStock.reservedQuantity; posted: locked, GL materialised, contributes to stock-ledger SUM; cancelled: terminal, releases reservation, excluded from stock-ledger SUM.
lifecycleState.title: Lifecycle State

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Operator is composing the move. Quantity reserved against source InventoryStock.reservedQuantity. Editable; no GL posting; no immutability lock.

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Immutable. Locked=true; postedAt set; InventoryStock.quantity updated at source (debit) and destination (credit); GL transaction materialised when movementType is receipt / issue / manufacture. Subsequent edits are rejected with HTTP 409: cancellation creates an offsetting move.

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.description: Terminal. cancelledAt set; reservation released. From draft: no offset row needed (no posting happened). From posted: StockMoveOffsetCreator emits a balanced offsetting StockMove with swapped source/destination, movementReason='cancellation', notes referencing the original, offsetOfMoveId set.

post.label: Post move
post.description: Commit the draft. Releases reservation; updates InventoryStock.quantity on both sides; materialises a balanced GLTransaction for receipt / issue / manufacture. Locked thereafter.

actions.description: Stamp postedAt and locked=true on transition.
Release reservedQuantity and decrement source / increment destination InventoryStock.quantity +. CAS optimistic-lock on InventoryStock.version; collision surfaces to operator with retry message.

Receipt debits Inventory Asset / credits Goods-in-Transit; issue debits COGS / credits Inventory Asset; manufacture debits Finished Goods / credits Raw Materials. transfer and repack are lateral (no GL). Amount per line = quantity * unitCost, currency = administration base. GL lines carry subLedgerType='inventory', subLedgerRef=<StockMove.id>.

cancel.label: Cancel move
cancel.description: From draft: release reservation, mark cancelled, no offset row. From posted: emit an offsetting StockMove (StockMoveOffsetCreator) that reverses the on-hand effect with swapped source/destination, then reverse the original GLTransaction +. The original posted row is NOT patched: immutability preserved.

actions.description: Stamp cancelledAt and force movementReason='cancellation' on the cancellation transition.
Draft-cancel path: only the reservation needs releasing; no on-hand change since posting never happened.

Posted-cancel path: emit a balanced offsetting StockMove with sourceLocationId / destinationLocationId swapped, quantity preserved, movementReason='cancellation', notes='Offset for <original.movementNumber>', offsetOfMoveId=<original.id>. The original posted row stays immutable; the offset is itself posted (locked) so the InventoryStock.quantity nets to zero and the GLTransaction is reversed by the same materialise-gl-transaction rule applied to the offset.

receiptHasNoSource.condition: movementType == 'receipt' AND sourceLocationId IS NOT NULL

issueHasNoDestination.condition: movementType == 'issue' AND destinationLocationId IS NOT NULL

transferHasBothLocations.condition: movementType IN ('transfer', 'manufacture', 'repack') AND (sourceLocationId IS NULL OR destinationLocationId IS NULL)
transferHasBothLocations.message: Transfer / manufacture / repack movements require both sourceLocationId and destinationLocationId.
transferHasBothLocations.messageNl: Overdracht / productie / herverpakking vereisen zowel een bron- als bestemmingslocatie.

sourceDifferentFromDestination.condition: sourceLocationId IS NOT NULL AND destinationLocationId IS NOT NULL AND sourceLocationId == destinationLocationId
sourceDifferentFromDestination.message: Source and destination locations must differ.

lockedRejectsEdits.condition: @current.locked == true AND (CHANGED(quantity) OR CHANGED(unitCost) OR CHANGED(sourceLocationId) OR CHANGED(destinationLocationId) OR CHANGED(movementType) OR CHANGED(itemId))
lockedRejectsEdits.message: Move is locked; cancellation creates offset.
lockedRejectsEdits.messageNl: Boeking is vergrendeld; annuleren maakt een tegenboeking aan.

netQuantityForLocation.description: Stock-ledger reconciliation: InventoryStock.quantity = initialStock + SUM(destination posted moves) - SUM(source posted moves). Excludes cancelled rows.
netQuantityForLocation.expression: SUM(quantity WHERE destinationLocationId = @location AND itemId = @item) - SUM(quantity WHERE sourceLocationId = @location AND itemId = @item)
netQuantityForLocation.description_long: Powers the Stock Ledger drill-down view and the InventoryStock reconciliation check.

reservedQuantityForLocation.description: Reserved-stock visibility: SUM(draft moves whose source is this location for this item). Powers the Reserved Stock index and the Available = quantity - reservedQty breakdown on the InventoryStock detail.

movesByType.description: Stock Movements index filter aggregation: count of moves per movementType for the dashboard tile.

x-openregister-indexes.description: Sequential movement number unique per administration.

objects.notes: Initial supplier delivery for catalog seed.
